$comment: Bounded, committed waiver for the Production E2E gate.
RULES ENFORCED BY scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (not by convention):
1. A waived test still RUNS. Nothing is skipped or deleted.
2. Past `expires`, the gate FAILS on the waiver itself. It cannot rot.
3. A waived test that starts PASSING fails the gate until it is removed
— unless marked `unstable`, which means it is waived because it flaps.
4. Any failure NOT listed here fails the gate normally.
5. Window capped at 30 days; policy path hard-coded in the script.
6. Entries are keyed on file + test title, never on line numbers.
History: Production E2E had never been green — 0 successes in 405 runs since
2026-05-17. main @ b2ee7c88 = 57 failed / 177 passed. First green: run
31704457154. Merged to main 2026-08-15 (9fc9f812); Production E2E green on
main at run 31904732747.
2026-08-15, third pass — the two big clusters are FIXED at the root and are
gone from this list:
ide-account-theme (6) -> REAL PRODUCT BUG. defaultIdeSettingsState() hard-
coded `theme: 'dark'`, and a project with no saved IDE settings always
hits that default. BaseChat then applied it over the document AND wrote
it into localStorage `bolt_theme`, flipping the whole app to dark and
overriding an explicit light choice — the exact failure mode the comment
in resolveProjectThemePreference() says the code is meant to avoid.
Defaulting to 'system' restores the documented behaviour. 6/6 green.
ide-command-palette -> the palette entries are <Link role="option"> in a
listbox, so getByRole('link') could never match, and the destination h1
is 'Import a Git repository'. Green.
3 left, each needing something this pass could not settle.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › IDE applies section 12 UI detail styles
waived.reason: Real design-token divergence, not a test problem: with the surface correctly pinned to dark, a radius still reads 6px where the spec says 4px. Needs design arbitration on which value is right before the test can be trusted either way.
